name: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students (Guidelines 2026-27)
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

rules.quote: Those SC students having total annual family income from all sources up to Rs. 8.00 lakh
total annual family income from all sources up to Rs. 8.00 lakh

value: notified/empanelled institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, NLUs etc.)
rules.quote: having secured admission in a full-time prescribed course in any of the notified institutions
Students of 2 nd /3 rd /4 th year will not be eligible for selection for fresh scholarship.
Thirty percent (30%) of slots allotted to the Institution shall be reserved for eligible SC girl students as per their inter-se merit.
The benefit of the Scheme will not be provided to more than 2 siblings

amount.text: Full tuition and non-refundable charges (cap Rs 2 lakh p.a. in private institutions) plus academic allowance Rs 86,000 first year and Rs 41,000 each later year
amount.quote: Academic allowance of Rs. 86,000 in the first year of study and Rs. 41,000 in every subsequent year

documents.name: Income certificate (Tehsildar or employer)
documents.quote: Income declaration of self-employed parents/guardian should be in the form of a certificate issued by revenue officer not below the rank of Tehsildar.

documents.name: Caste certificate, bank details, admission rank, fee details on NSP
documents.quote: upload their income certificate and caste certificate on the Portal along with details of their bank account, Admission Rank and Fee details

deadline.text: NSP lists student application close 31-10-2026; guideline sets institute verification by 31 October each year
deadline.quote: The last date of verification of applications of the students by the institutions on NSP shall be 31 st of October every year
